items.headline: 30th Celebration Expansion Product Lineup Revealed
items.label: set reveal
items.summary: On June 30, 2026, The Pokémon Company International detailed products for the 30th Celebration expansion, releasing worldwide September 16, 2026. It features all-foil cards, a new Futuristic rare illustrated by YOSHIROTTEN, 30 Pikachu rares per booster, daytime/nighttime variants, and 30 returning classic Pokémon. Products include Elite Trainer Box (9 packs + Nidorina promo), Poster Collection (3 packs + legendary bird promos), Tech Sticker Collection, Pokémon ex Box, and ex Tin.
action: Monitor sealed product preorders for potential early price spikes due to anniversary hype and new rarity
Consider investing in ETBs or collections featuring unique promos for long-term collector value

items.headline: Mega Evolution—Pitch Black Products Launch in July
items.label: release
items.summary: Multiple products from the Mega Evolution—Pitch Black expansion (featuring Mega Darkrai-ex) became available or were detailed in early July 2026. Key releases include Booster Display Boxes and Elite Trainer Boxes on July 17, plus Build & Battle Boxes on July 31. The set emphasizes dark-themed Mega Evolutions.
action: Track ETB and display box pricing post-release for potential short-term market corrections or spikes
Prioritize Pokémon Center exclusive ETBs for bonus promos if seeking higher-value variants

items.headline: Mega Greninja ex Premium Collection Releases July 3
items.label: release
items.summary: The Mega Greninja ex Premium Collection launched July 3, 2026, including a foil promo in playable and display sizes, tech sticker, and eight booster packs from the Pitch Black set. It highlights Greninja's Mortal Shuriken ability for competitive play.
action: Evaluate sealed collections for quick flips if demand surges around the popular Mega evolution

items.headline: Storm Emeralda Japan Merchandise Revealed
items.label: set reveal
items.summary: On or around July 24, 2026, merchandise for the Japanese Mega Evolution set Storm Emeralda (ME 6, releasing July 31, 2026) was revealed, featuring Mega Rayquaza ex. This follows earlier announcements of the set's dark evolution theme.
action: Watch Japanese import sealed product for early allocation and potential premium pricing ahead of English equivalents

items.headline: GemRate Updates Grading Trends Through July 2026
items.label: grading
items.summary: As of July 27, 2026, GemRate reported recent PSA grading volumes (e.g., ~21k cards graded on a recent day, trailing 30-day totals down ~3%). TCG market share data and population insights continue to influence collector strategies amid steady but slightly declining volumes.
